answer.reason: Two events happened at Shunem: the Philistines camped there, and Elisha lodged there with a great woman.

clauses.english: was where the Philistines gathered and pitched their camp
clauses.quote: gathered themselves together, and came and pitched in Shunem

clauses.english: was where Elisha often ate with a great woman and lodged in her chamber
clauses.quote: Elisha passed to Shunem, where was a great woman

doubts: JOS 19:18 only lists Shunem as a border town of Issachar, so it was left out.
1KI 1:3 and 1KI 2:17-21 name Abishag the Shunammite, and these verses say nothing of the town itself, so they were left out.
